en: This is a vintage illustrated postcard depicting a large train station with a neoclassical facade, labeled 'GRAZ Bahnhof.' The scene includes two trams or streetcars on tracks approaching the station, carriages, and people walking or standing in front of the building. There is handwritten text in ink and pencil across the postcard, including a visible date '3.4.1901.' The bottom of the card credits 'Kunstverlag Rafael Neuber Wien.'
